forwarder_said: "Confirmed, 5 pieces, 1,500 kg... the shipment now also includes lithium-ion batteries packed with the equipment. Paperwork to follow."
message_to_send: Dear Omar, thank you for confirming 5 pieces, 1,500 kg. As the shipment now includes lithium-ion batteries, our cargo acceptance team will review it. Please send the UN number and the signed Shipper's Declaration for Dangerous Goods. The booking is not changed until they decide. Kind regards, Falcon Cargo Air capacity team.
why: Trigger: the cargo itself changes (Escalation 2.6); the cargo acceptance team must decide whether the shipment can be accepted as dangerous goods; release 0 kg. Rules check: 7.1 declared as dangerous goods - not met (booking still GEN); 7.2 flight FCA 201 dg_accepted yes and forwarder F-03 dg_certified yes - met; 7.3 UN number and signed Shipper's Declaration - missing information (paperwork to follow); 7.4 batteries packed with equipment, not on their own, and flight is a freighter - met; 7.5 DG acceptance check at the terminal - still required. Sources: booking B-05, forwarder F-03, message M-05, FCA 201 record, Escalation 1.3, 2.6, Rules 7.1-7.5.
